name: yas-microservices
benchmark_purpose: Enterprise PII benchmark for service-to-service PII movement in a Spring Boot ecommerce mesh (customer identity, addresses, cart, order, payment, delivery stub, notification/webhook).
inaccessible_items: Full docker compose startup not executed during Phase 1 documentation
Maven (mvn) not installed on inspection host
Usable system Java runtime not available on inspection host (java -version failed)
delivery service is a stub (empty controller/service) — no runtime delivery PII paths implemented
webhook and recommendation services are commented out in docker-compose.yml
No dedicated notification microservice; webhook event notifications are the closest analogue
SonarCloud token and GHCR publish credentials are upstream CI secrets — unavailable here
Azure OpenAI embedding keys referenced in .env for recommendation — not validated
